Senses.Note: The phrase pictures double doors opened outward like the spreading strokes of the graph eight; masters use it for a gate, disclosure, or public presentation that leaves no concealment while still requiring the visitor to enter or recognize it.

Occurrences.Kwic: 其有諸佛說不盡底。祖師提不起處。對眾八字打開去也。
Occurrences.AttributionNote: Source record (T/T47/T47n1997.xml). Recorded Sayings of Chan Master Yuanwu Foguo. Exact utterer: Yuanwu Keqin. Yuanwu Keqin says he will open wide before the assembly what buddhas cannot finish saying and patriarchs cannot lift.

Occurrences.Kwic: 山僧曲為諸人八字打開去也。
Occurrences.AttributionNote: Source record (J/J28/J28nB202.xml). Recorded Sayings of Chan Master Baichi. Exact utterer: Baichi Xingyuan. Baichi Xingyuan says that, as an accommodation, he will open it wide for the assembly.

Occurrences.Kwic: 三門。云：「乾坤作殿，日月為門，八字打開，亦任縱橫。
Occurrences.AttributionNote: Source record (J/J40/J40nB479.xml). Recorded Sayings of Chan Master Zhufengxu of Zhaojue. Exact utterer: Zhufeng Zhenxu. At the monastery gate, Zhufeng Zhenxu says the gate stands wide open and permits free passage.

Occurrences.Kwic: 至山門，云：「從上已來，閑門破戶，一時八字打開了也。
Occurrences.AttributionNote: Source record (J/J27/J27nB193.xml). Recorded Sayings of Chan Master Yinyuan. Exact utterer: Yinyuan Longqi. Arriving at the monastery gate, Yinyuan Longqi says all idle doors and ruined houses have been thrown wide open at once.

Occurrences.Kwic: 山僧即將從上來事八字打開，盡情分付了也。
Occurrences.AttributionNote: Source record (J/J28/J28nB203.xml). Recorded Sayings of Chan Master Yune Xi. Exact utterer: Yun'e Xi. Yun’e Xi says he has opened the inherited matter wide and entrusted it without reserve.

Occurrences.Kwic: 八字打開，君須自薦，直下翻身，頓超方便。
Occurrences.AttributionNote: Source record (J/J26/J26nB178.xml). Recorded Sayings of Chan Master Feiyin. Exact utterer: Feiyin Tongrong. Feiyin Tongrong says the matter is wide open but the listener must recognize it personally and turn at once.

Occurrences.Kwic: 解脫門八字打開，沒量漢今朝始至
Occurrences.AttributionNote: Source record (J/J26/J26nB186.xml). Recorded Sayings of Chan Master Linyexi. Exact utterer: Linye Tongqi. At his arrival, Linye Tongqi says the gate of release stands wide open and the immeasurable fellow has only now arrived.

Senses.Explanation: Thrown wide open describes an unobstructed opening, often enacted at a gate or in an address that claims nothing is being withheld. Yinyuan Longqi, Zhufeng Zhenxu, and Linye Tongqi speak at literal monastery gates, making the door image visible. Yuanwu Keqin, Baichi Xingyuan, and Yun’e Xi use the same image for public disclosure or entrustment. Feiyin Tongrong supplies the limit: although it is wide open, the listener must recognize it personally and turn.
